simple.meaning: נָשָׁא (nâshâʼ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to lend on interest; by implication, to dun for debt.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across 1 Samuel, 1 Kings, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at 1 Samuel 22:2. Its contexts include altar, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָשָׁא (H5378).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נָשָׁא (nâshâʼ) / H5378 is traced through 1 Samuel 22:2, 1 Kings 8:31, Psalms 89:23, Isaiah 24:2 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to lend on interest; by implication, to dun for debt
definitions.full: H5378. nasha I. [ נָשָׁא ] verb lend on interest, or usury, be a creditor (compare Arabic postpone, delay; sell on credit ; || form of I. נָשָׁה , see Ges § 75oo ); — Qal Participle active נשֶׁא (analogous ׳ל ה ) 1Sam 22:2 every man that had a creditor ; בוֺ נשֶׁא אֲשֶׁר Isa 24:2 against whom is a ceditor , and plural נשְׁאִים Neh 5:7 Kt ( נשִׁים Qr, from נָשָׁה ), + accusative of congnate meaning with verb מַשָּׁא . Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular בּוֺ אוֺיֵב לֹאיַֿשִּׁיא Psa 89:23 an enemy shall not act the creditor against him, make exactions of him (|| יְעַנֶּנּוּ ). — 1Kin 8:31 ; 2Chr 6:22 see נשׂא Qal 1 b (5). I. נָשָׁה verb lend, become a creditor (compare I. נשׁא ); — Qal Perfect 1singular נָשִׁ֫יתִי Jer 15:10 ; 3 plural נָשׁוּ 15:10 ; Participle נשֶׁה Exod 22:24 4 t.; plural נשִׁים Neh 5:10-11 , + 5:7 Qr (Kt נשְׁאִים , see I. נשׁא ), suffix נוֺשַׁי Isa 50:1 ; — lend , usually with ב person: וְלֹאנָֿשׁוּבִֿי לֹאנָֿשִׁיתִי Jer 15:10 I have not lent, and they have not lent to me , Deut 24:11 ; Neh 5:7 (Qr; + accusative of congnate meaning with verb), 5:10 ; 5:11 (both + accusative of thing); participle as substantive creditor, usurer Exod 22:24 (E), 2Kin 4:1 ; Isa 24:2 ; 50:1 ; Psa 109:11 . Hiph`il Imperfect 3masculine singular בְּ יַשֶּׁה Deut 15:2 who lendeth to his neighbour; 2 masculine singular בְּ תַּשֶּׁה 24:10 when thou lendest to thy neighbour (+ accusative of congnate meaning with verb).
